SELECT nr.record_id, nr.visit_id, nr.recorded_at, nr.status, nr.respiration, nr.observation, nr.systolic_bp, nr.diastolic_bp, nr.pulse, nr.temperature, nr.CONSCIOUSNESS_LEVEL, nr.spo2, nr.INITIAL_ASSESSMENT, e.name AS nurseName, d.dept_name, en.shift_type, rc.PATIENT_Id, nr.height_cm, nr.weight_kg
FROM CHJ.NURSING_RECORD nr
JOIN JCH.EMPLOYEE_NURSE en ON nr.nursing_id = en.staff_id JOIN JCH.EMPLOYEE e ON en.staff_id = e.staff_id JOIN JCH.DEPARTMENT d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN HOSPITAL.CLINICAL_VISIT cv ON TO_CHAR(cv.VISIT_ID) = nr.VISIT_ID JOIN HOSPITAL.RECEPTION rc ON cv.RECEPTION_ID = rc.RECEPTION_ID
nr.record_id = #{searchValue}
e.name LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'
nr.recorded_at BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDate} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
1=0 -- 위에 조건 두 개가 거짓이면, 값을 반환하지 않는다. 1=0 은 거짓이기 때문에, 빈 결과를 반환한다. -- 이 조건문이 없으면 전체 목록을 가져오는 쿼리문이 완성된다.
ORDER BY nr.record_id DESC

SELECT nr.record_id, nr.visit_id, nr.recorded_at, nr.respiration, nr.status, nr.observation, nr.systolic_bp, nr.diastolic_bp, nr.pulse, nr.temperature, nr.CONSCIOUSNESS_LEVEL, nr.spo2, nr.INITIAL_ASSESSMENT, e.name AS nurseName, d.dept_name, en.shift_type, rc.PATIENT_Id, nr.height_cm, nr.weight_kg
FROM CHJ.NURSING_RECORD nr
JOIN JCH.EMPLOYEE_NURSE en ON nr.nursing_id = en.staff_id JOIN JCH.EMPLOYEE e ON en.staff_id = e.staff_id JOIN JCH.DEPARTMENT d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN HOSPITAL.CLINICAL_VISIT cv ON TO_CHAR(cv.VISIT_ID) = nr.VISIT_ID JOIN HOSPITAL.RECEPTION rc ON cv.RECEPTION_ID = rc.RECEPTION_ID
ORDER BY nr.recorded_at DESC NULLS LAST, nr.record_id DESC

SELECT nr.record_id, nr.visit_id, nr.recorded_at, nr.status, nr.respiration, nr.observation, nr.systolic_bp, nr.diastolic_bp, nr.pulse, nr.temperature, nr.spo2, nr.nursing_id, nr.consciousness_level, nr.initial_assessment, TO_CHAR(nr.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at, nr.height_cm, nr.weight_kg, e.name AS nurse_name, en.shift_type, cv.reception_id, rc.PATIENT_Id, nr.pain_score FROM CHJ.NURSING_RECORD nr JOIN JCH.EMPLOYEE_NURSE en ON nr.nursing_id = en.staff_id JOIN JCH.EMPLOYEE e ON en.staff_id = e.staff_id JOIN HOSPITAL.CLINICAL_VISIT cv ON TO_CHAR(cv.VISIT_ID) = nr.VISIT_ID JOIN HOSPITAL.RECEPTION rc ON cv.RECEPTION_ID = rc.RECEPTION_ID WHERE nr.record_id = #{recordId}
